about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.
plan: Shared by all six shots and recorded in README.md's capture block: window 1440x763 on the deployed build at ?dev=1&seed=60, DEV.boot(); DEV.freeze(true); DEV.tick(30), then DEV.cam(...) and one DEV.tick(1) per shot, vitals pinned at 100, the level's own hostiles cleared (never DEV.clear()), level banner taken down with banner('', 0). A frozen clock does not stop S.t, so these frames are reproducible by statistics and never by md5. **One term this plan did not record: the audio device.** A live boot advances the seeded stream through SND.init's noise buffer before the generator runs, so one seed deals one level per sample rate (#404, and the rule the tool prints as HW_WHY). These six captures read no SND.ac.sampleRate, so every row carries `sampleRate: null`, `check` prints each one as a device-scoped deal, and the binding below is per-machine: it says this frame is what ?dev=1&seed=60 dealt on the capture's audio device, not that every machine deals it. `STRICT=1 node tools/recap.js check` gates the missing term. A capture that reads the rate turns its own row into a cross-machine binding with no change to the tool.

shots.note: Deal transcribed from README.md's capture block, which names all six shots as one route: the deployed page opened at ?dev=1&seed=60, build proved by eval-visible code markers, every deployed js blob md5-identical to the tree at ce9d39d. layout is that block's DEV.layoutSig() for the deal. Pose: one posed grunt 6 m out on the camera's own band (a posed body added with DEV.spawn, never DEV.clear, which would leave 0 LEFT on the HUD).

Same route as level0-spawn; see that row for where each field was recorded. Shot 8be1f96 is the one whose caption names black air above the four risers - the reason #333 reopened, and the reason this artifact exists.
Same route as level0-spawn. Feet on floor -1.00 in the pit, lamp at (20.5, 16.5) one cell over - a pose named in the caption, so the deal field is what makes it re-takeable rather than a description.
Same route as level0-spawn. The pit lip from 2.5 m out; the props the caption counts (9 lamps, 7 crates, 7 barrels) are this deal's, which is why seed and layout are gated and the counts are not.

The reference shot for the block: the route and every deal field in these six rows are transcribed from README.md's capture block (deployed build, ?dev=1&seed=60, DEV.layoutSig 735688443, js blobs md5-identical to ce9d39d) rather than re-measured here. #335 measured this route: reloading the same URL read DEV.seed 60 and layout 735688443 on both loads, which is what makes origin+install=url-open a binding route.

Re-taken from the deployed Pages build of main, second time (#431). The build is proved off the wire before the shutter, not from memory: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs the page served were md5-compared against origin/main at a61b540 and all twelve matched, so these pixels came off the page that serves a61b540 - the one that carries #369's finale deck repaint (floorBias 0.12, readable in the served js/20_level.js) as well as #428's WT.SLAB wall repaint. Nothing here is filled in from a local tree (#395, #420).  Route is the URL itself, unchanged from the row this replaces: headless Chromium opened this row's url at a 1440x763 device-metrics override at scale 1 and, once the page reported DEV/startLevel/floorAt live, ran DEV.boot(); startLevel(3, true); banner('', 0); DEV.freeze(true); DEV.tick(30); P.hp = 100; DEV.cam(1.5, 2.5, floorAt(1.5, 2.5), 0.60, 0); DEV.tick(1), leaving the level's own 4 hostiles standing (grunt, grunt, hound, brute, all asleep - no DEV.clear); S.mode read 'play' before and after the shutter; props 9, lights 11, SND.ac.sampleRate 44100, so this row is a cross-machine binding. Page screenshot re-encoded as colour type 2 by tools/png_rgb.js (--check reports type 2 1440x763, no alpha).  WHAT MOVED, against the bytes this row replaces (1110fd08, drawn at 12bdefa): mean 66.75 -> 64.98, thirds 45.6/76.1/78.7 -> 45.6/74.2/75.2 (recap's own band means), dark rows at the tool's threshold 24 stay 0 of 763, at 34 46 -> 47 with the longest run 42 from row 260, and 405,884 of 1,098,720 px shift by more than 2 luma (36.94 %, mean |delta| over those px 5.2, worst 72, only 143 px over 50). This move has ONE cause and it is small: #369 stops the finale's deck burning past the picture it is lit for, so the deck third falls 3.5 and the wall and vault do not move - a wide, shallow pixel diff, not a repaint. The previous row's 63 % >2-luma move at mean |delta| 26.6 was three changes at once; this one is 37 % at 5.2. By band on the two files: deck y 520-763 77.51 -> 74.06, wall patch x 660-1295 x y 340-422 100.40 -> 97.08 (both the deck's own lit pixels bleeding into that window), vault y 0-240 45.88 -> 45.87 - the roof is unchanged to 0.01 luma, which is the assertion the caption makes.  Two page loads of this route at this build both read DEV.layoutSig() 1699332737 and canvas means 66.273 / 66.280 (in-page reads, ahead of the screenshot encode), so this pair of shutters agrees; the row this replaces recorded 972763321 and 164933889 across two loads of its own build. The layout is still a property of the run, not of the url - #420's stream pin, recorded again rather than re-run until a favourite number came back.  Geometry is not among the things that moved and the caption still asserts it, so it was read back off the same page at this seat: own cell 1,2 air, floor 0.00, own ceiling 1.00, MAP.cz 4, MAP.light 0.102; the seventh cell along the heading (7.28, 6.45) is air at floor 0.00 with its ceiling solving at 4.00. The frame mean this row carries (64.98) is the number README.md's decode list and this seat's caption quote, decoded by tools/recap.js from these bytes. #431 is the re-take, #395 the caption that cannot go false, #420 the stream pin that would make a re-take a fact of the url.

ABATOIR CORE's arrival seat, first frame for this level. Route is the URL itself and the plan above, with one addition this level needs: DEV.boot(); startLevel(2, true); banner('', 0); DEV.freeze(true); DEV.tick(30); P.hp = 100; DEV.cam(18.5, 23.5, floorAt(18.5, 23.5), 0.60, 0); DEV.tick(1); the level's own 18 hostiles left standing; S.mode read 'play' immediately before the shutter. The page served js/40_render.js 2460c908, js/20_level.js 5923d2f7 and js/90_dev.js e8c0a3eb, each md5-identical to the tree at dac241d, and the live renderer's CF_SPILL_R2 read 4, so the hung-fitting terms are in the pixels. DEV.state() read seed 60, layout 3946763407 and SND.ac.sampleRate 44100, so unlike the six older rows this is a cross-machine binding, and both of this level's rows read the same layout at the same rate. Re-encoded through tools/png_rgb.js to colour type 2.

The same seat, same deal, same page load rules, turned to the fitting this deal puts over the entry circulation: DEV.cam(18.5, 23.5, floorAt(...), -0.556, 25). MAP.ceilPanes for this layout holds six entries and the one 3.06 m from the seat at bearing -0.556 rad is the one in this frame, hung with its lens at 2.35 m under a 4.00 m slab; MAP.ceilFix marks its cell 2 (canopy on the slab, lens on the stem), which is the tall-room form. The slab's left third is the doorway wall the seat stands in, 1 m away - it is in the picture the player sees when they turn, and it is why this frame is not a clean room shot. Same seed/level/sampleRate as level2-abatoir and the same layout 3946763407, so the two rows are one world at two headings. S.mode read 'play'; colour type 2 via tools/png_rgb.js.
